第7章 那就是没得商量了（第1页）
重活一世，叶楚尘的心已经彻底凉透了。
他对叶鼎这个父亲，对叶灵儿这个妹妹，对叶寒、叶清清等几个姐姐
心中再也没有对亲情一丝一毫的留恋。
他只想儘快离开这个伤心地，离开这个埋骨地！
离开这个因他叶楚尘而强势崛起的不朽世家——叶家！
回想起上一世自己为叶家、为父亲叶鼎、为妹妹、为姐姐们做的一切，叶楚尘自嘲般笑笑。
神体破碎，修为被废后的叶楚尘，在叶家地位直线下降，慢慢就被疏远，被边缘化。
为了討好父亲和几个姐姐，叶楚尘付出了太多太多。
冒死进深山大泽中採摘灵药九阳草，自己捨不得服用，满怀期待地送给妹妹叶灵儿强健筋骨，祛除体內杂质。
可叶灵儿看自己的眼神就像在看一个乞丐，强忍著噁心接过九阳草，当著叶楚尘的面，用清水洗了好几遍，转身笑盈盈地送给一旁的叶轩
三姐叶清清突破在即，叶楚尘拖著病躯，三天三夜不眠不休为其炼製破厄丹。
丹炉炸了几次，叶楚尘灰头土脸、遍体鳞伤，好不容易將破厄丹炼成，欣喜若狂地將破厄丹送到三姐叶清清面前，却被叶清清捏著鼻子隨手丟给餵养的狗吃，还让叶楚尘没事不要出现在她面前，影响空气流速。
五姐叶寒修炼阵法一道，叶楚尘便將自己钻研的阵法大道抄录下来，送给五姐叶寒观摩。
他修为虽废，但对阵法一道的研究尚在，毫不夸张的说，整个荒古大陆年轻一辈中，除了魔道女帝林书望，阵法一道，无人能出其左右。
只要五姐叶寒按照叶楚尘抄录下来的阵法大道修炼，成为阵法宗师不过是时间问题。
可五姐叶寒苦修阵法无果，闭关多日后连最基本的阵法都构建不成功，正是心烦意乱之时，突然见到叶楚尘满脸兴奋地衝到自己面前，心里头那个火啊。
“叶楚尘，你不知道我在闭关吗？这时候来打搅我，是想让我走火入魔？”
“你这个废物，肯定也想让我变成跟你一样的废物，你心思怎么这么歹毒？！”
叶楚尘半张著嘴，解释的话还没说出口，便觉一道凌厉的灵力袭来。
伴隨著清脆的骨裂声和悽厉的惨叫声，五姐叶寒硬生生敲断叶楚尘的一条腿。
全然不顾被自己敲断一条腿的叶楚尘，五姐叶寒眼角余光微瞥，看到叶楚尘手里攥著的阵法大道后，伸手一抓，便隔空將其摄入掌心。
“太好了，有了这本《阵法大道我和小轩一定能成为阵法宗师！”
“你这个废物也真是的，送我东西也不知道挑个时候，鬼鬼祟祟的我还以为你是来害我的，活该被打断一条腿。”
话音刚落，五姐叶寒全然不顾在地上痛苦挣扎的叶楚尘，握著《阵法大道哼著小曲儿，走进密室，继续闭关。
而他叶楚尘则瘸著一条腿，在地上挣扎许久后，才勉强站立起来，然后杵著一根木棍，一瘸一拐的离开。
叶楚尘清楚地记得，那天的雨很大，大到湿了他的眼眶。
已故的母亲除外，叶家几个兄弟姐妹能够在年轻一辈中脱颖而出，能够在丹道、炼器、阵法、符籙上取得成就，都与他叶楚尘离不开关係！！
甚至就连资质平平的父亲叶鼎，能够顺利突破至圣境，稳坐叶家家主的位置，也是因为他叶楚尘。
叶家老祖叶山河气血亏败、寿数將近，却能在行將就木之年衝击准帝秘境
这一切的一切，都离不开他叶楚尘！
当他叶楚尘修为被废，不能修行后，这一身气运便会散落叶家，福泽整个叶家。
混沌神体虽然破碎，但他叶楚尘体內流淌的血液中，依旧蕴含著一丝混沌气。

Chapter 7 That means there is no need to discuss (Page 1)
After reviving his life, Ye Chuchen's heart was completely cold.
He treats Ye Ding as his father, Ye Ling'er as his sister, and Ye Han, Ye Qingqing and other sisters.
There is no longer any nostalgia for family affection in my heart.
He just wanted to leave this sad place and this burial ground as soon as possible!
Leave this immortal family that rose to power because of Ye Chuchen - the Ye family!
Recalling everything he had done for the Ye family, his father Ye Ding, his sister, and his sisters in his previous life, Ye Chuchen smiled to himself.
After his divine body was broken and his cultivation was abolished, Ye Chuchen's status in the Ye family plummeted, and he was gradually alienated and marginalized.
In order to please his father and several sisters, Ye Chuchen paid too much.
Risking his own life, he went into the mountains and swamps to pick the elixir Jiuyang grass. He couldn't bear to take it himself, and gave it to his younger sister Ye Ling'er with great expectations to strengthen the muscles and bones and remove impurities from the body.
But Ye Ling'er looked at her like a beggar. She suppressed her nausea and took the Nine Sun Grass. In front of Ye Chuchen, she washed it several times with water, turned around and gave it to Ye Xuan with a smile.
The third sister, Ye Qingqing, was about to make a breakthrough. Ye Chuchen, dragging his sick body, stayed awake for three days and three nights to refine the PoE Dan for him.
The alchemy furnace exploded several times, and Ye Chuchen was disgraced and covered in bruises. He finally made Po'er Dan and happily sent it to his third sister, Ye Qingqing. However, Ye Qingqing pinched her nose and threw it to the feeding dog. Ye Chuchen also told Ye Chuchen not to appear in front of her because it would affect the air flow.
As the fifth sister Ye Han practiced the formation, Ye Chuchen copied down the formation method he had studied and gave it to the fifth sister Ye Han to observe.
Although his cultivation level is useless, he is still studying the formation method. It is no exaggeration to say that among the younger generation in the entire ancient continent, except for the Demon Empress Lin Shuwang, no one can surpass him in the formation method.
As long as fifth sister Ye Han practices according to the formation method copied by Ye Chuchen, it is only a matter of time before she becomes a formation master.
But the fifth sister, Ye Han, worked hard to practice the formation to no avail. After many days of seclusion, she could not even construct the most basic formation. Just when she was upset, she suddenly saw Ye Chuchen rushing in front of her with a face full of excitement, and her heart was filled with anger.
"Ye Chuchen, don't you know I'm in retreat? Are you disturbing me now to make me go crazy?"
"You trash, you definitely want me to become the same trash as you. Why are you so vicious?!"
Ye Chuchen's mouth was half-opened, but before he could say anything to explain, he felt a sharp spiritual power coming.
Accompanied by the crisp sound of bone cracking and a shrill scream, Fifth Sister Ye Han forcefully knocked off one of Ye Chuchen's legs.
Completely ignoring Ye Chuchen, who had one of his legs broken, fifth sister Ye Han glanced out of the corner of her eyes and saw the formation avenue in Ye Chuchen's hand. She stretched out her hand to grab it and took it into the palm of her hand.
"Great, with this book "The Avenue of Formation, Xiaoxuan and I will definitely become masters of the formation!"
"You are such a waste. You didn't know when to give me something. You were so sneaky that I thought you were here to harm me. You deserve to have one of your legs broken."
As soon as he finished speaking, the fifth sister Ye Han completely ignored Ye Chuchen who was struggling painfully on the ground. He held "The Avenue of Formation" and hummed a little tune, walked into the secret room and continued to retreat.
Ye Chuchen, on the other hand, was lame on one leg. After struggling on the ground for a long time, he managed to stand up, then limped away with a wooden stick in his hand.
Ye Chuchen clearly remembered that the rain that day was so heavy that it wet his eyes.
Except for his late mother, the fact that several brothers and sisters of the Ye family can stand out among the younger generation and achieve success in alchemy, weapon refining, formations, and talismans are all inseparable from Ye Chuchen! !
Even his father Ye Ding, who had mediocre qualifications, was able to successfully break through to the Holy Realm and securely occupy the position of the head of the Ye family because of him, Ye Chuchen.
The ancestor of the Ye family, Ye Shanhe, was depleted of energy and blood and was about to die, but he was able to break into the secret realm of the quasi-emperor in his dying years.
All of this is inseparable from him, Ye Chuchen!
When Ye Chuchen's cultivation was abolished and he could no longer practice, this destiny would be lost to the Ye family and bring blessings to the entire Ye family.
Although the Chaos Divine Body was broken, the blood flowing in Ye Chuchen's body still contained a trace of Chaos Qi.
